headline: Northeast flights resume after air-traffic outage, but delays linger
dek: New York-area airports returned to service Tuesday after a communications failure and severed backup fiber line disrupted flights across the region. Hundreds of cancellations at Newark and Philadelphia contributed to a backlog that was still affecting travelers.
body: Flights were operating again at New York City-area airports Tuesday, but delays and cancellations continued after a communications outage at a key Federal Aviation Administration air-traffic facility in Philadelphia disrupted travel across the Northeast, the Associated Press reported.

The FAA's primary communications circuit failed Monday morning. When controllers tried to switch to the backup, they found that its fiber-optic line had been cut by railroad construction workers, according to the FAA's account cited by AP. Controllers were left without radar or communications for hours.

More than 600 flights into and out of Newark Liberty International Airport were canceled Monday, and more than 200 were canceled at Philadelphia International Airport. No commercial flights landed at Newark from about 9:40 a.m. until shortly after 5:20 p.m. Monday, AP reported, citing Flightradar24. Disruptions also affected LaGuardia and Kennedy airports.

By early Tuesday, Newark still showed about 40 delays and nearly 60 cancellations on FlightAware. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said it would take time to clear the remaining delays, so travelers were advised to check directly with their airlines before heading to the airport.

The incident involved two communication paths failing in succession: the primary circuit failed first, and the backup fiber had already been severed during construction in New Jersey. AP reported that Amtrak and New Jersey Transit gave differing accounts about which railroad's crew was working in the area.
location: New York City area and Northeast
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Northeast flights resume after FAA air-traffic outage
seoDescription: Flights resumed after a communications outage at an FAA facility disrupted Northeast airports; cancellations and delays continued Tuesday.
